quiescence.note: The daily runtime was stopped before the backup so the backup and the hashes are taken against a quiescent database.
quiescence.walCheckpointNote: The daily runtime was stopped without a clean close, so the write-ahead log was still separate. Opening the database for the backup recovered and checkpointed it.

liveDatabase.sha256BeforeProofNote: Taken after the backup had already checkpointed the write-ahead log, so it is the post-checkpoint state, not the state while the daily server was running.

freshBackup.supersedes: backups/tabhub-2026-08-12T15-44-44.092Z.sqlite (stale, not used as the pre-rollout backup)

isolatedCopy.note: Throwaway copy of the fresh backup outside the repository; never the live file.
isolatedCopy.sha256AfterMigrationCaveat: Taken with an uncheckpointed -wal beside the file after a forced stop of the smoke process; the reported state is read through that WAL.

featureOffSmoke.note: Rollback (feature-off on schema 26) proven on the migrated copy before the live migration.
featureOffSmoke.environmentFile: none present; every feature flag resolves to its fail-closed default false

liveDatabaseWrittenNote: Corrected 2026-08-23 (issue #20). The earlier value of false contradicted the write-ahead-log checkpoint recorded beside it: taking the backup opened the live database, which recovered and checkpointed its write-ahead log into the main file. That is the only write this proof caused, and it happened BEFORE the first hash was taken. The unchanged-hash claim below therefore covers the migration proof itself, not the backup step that preceded it.
